purpose: Answer key for the GRADER, not for the skill. Each entry is a verdict established by reading the stored iteration-40 artefact, so a grading run can be scored for accuracy rather than only for self-agreement. Every prior grader measurement (temperature, --grade-runs, majority voting) measured precision; this measures whether the grader is right.

caveats: Entries are only valid while the assertion text and the stored output both stay unchanged. Changing either invalidates that row, not the whole key.

The sample is deliberately adversarial (40 firm FAIL-expected against 19 firm PASS-expected), because it is drawn from the failing set. The resulting score is accuracy on hard cases, NOT a suite-wide accuracy estimate — do not read it as 'the grader is right N% of the time'.
